shared_elements: tall monolithic stone block carved in low relief
horizontal band of repeated motifs running across the upper part
row of repeated U-shaped / lunate elements along the top edge
band of zigzag / chevron-like geometric ornament
paired curving lines descending from the upper zone (arm- or shoulder-like)
belt- or girdle-like horizontal division low on the shaft
justification: Both are upright monolithic blocks organised in the same vertical sequence: a row of repeated lunate elements at the very top, a horizontal band of geometric ornament beneath it, then a main field of relief motifs, with paired curving lines running down the sides and a belt-like division low on the shaft. The decisive difference is subject matter and finish  erwith B carrying crisply cut animals in profile (quadruped, bird, elongated creature) on pale stone, while A's field is filled with abstract discs, rings and scrolls in soft, rounded relief on dark stone.
